T3_CONVENTION_CAVEAT: CONDITIONAL. T3 assumes the full twist acts on S^lambda by q^{content sum} -- exponent alpha = 1. That convention is TAKEN FROM the corpus (AGENTS.md / qou-7dzg: 'For Hecke its exponent is the content sum'), NOT derived here. Under any alpha > 0 the spectrum is {q^{3a}, 1, q^{-3a}}, so q^-3 lands on (1^3) IFF alpha = 1. T1 and T2 do not depend on alpha; T3 does.
T4_verdict: q^-3 equals the (1^3) content sum exactly (-3). It is NOT the three-component fundamental-colour Casimir total (9), and gzs0's '-2 per component' is a re-reading of the same -3 total via T/2, not an independent per-component fact: nothing in F_Bor is indexed by component.
